subject: Assistant Estimator (SEEK 95364044), Marc Masarate

letter.company_line: Urbania delivers playgrounds, parks, streetscapes and urban precincts for councils, schools and developers, with hard and soft landscaping, civil construction and structural concreting.
letter.subject: Assistant Estimator, Thomastown (SEEK 95364044)
paragraphs: I saw your Assistant Estimator advert on SEEK. You say the role suits a recent civil engineering graduate, and I finished my Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, so I am applying.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2014 to 2019). The Advanced Diploma at Albright Institute covered cost estimates and bills of quantities alongside road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings against project requirements, tracked procurement and materials, kept material records and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers. Reading drawings and keeping supplier records are a big part of the role you describe.

Your work on playgrounds, parks and streetscapes, with earthworks, drainage and concreting for councils and schools, is work I would like to learn to price. My estimating so far is from coursework rather than a paid role, and I have not used takeoff software such as Plan Swift, so I would start at graduate level and learn your methods. I am based in Melton VIC with a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
I have attached my resume and would be glad to talk about the role.
